d: In this insightful episode of ‘Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra’, filmmaker Kiran Rao opens up about the changing landscape of Hindi cinema, evolving audience behavior, OTT culture, and the challenges of filmmaking today. From the making on ‘Taare Zameen Par' to the importance of editing and storytelling, Kiran shares honest perspectives and behind-the-scenes experiences from her cinematic journey.
